subtitle: the header's line, set from the cart's interval where the painting set 'The crown's cart returns every four hours.' -- ivory #E7E7E7 ink x 181..690, y 294..327 on the painting (278..311 here), which Garamond 30 matches: 28 set the painted line 474 wide against its 509.

cart: one place in the yard, a painted cart lit (waiting) or grey (empty), centred where the painting has its three -- x 214.5, 285.5, 356.5, y 1115.5 -- inside the stock panel (x 168..398, y 1069..1159). A yard of another size spreads its places evenly over the panel (ChestsView.cart_places).
timer: the time to the next cart in the hourglass panel's empty plate (inside x 495..620, y 1087..1137), Garamond 30 as the Court's lines; 'Full' when the yard is.
open, info: OPEN where it was painted; the (i) coin drawn where it was painted (info_coin) under a tap area 95 x 97 units -- 44 pt -- from OPEN's edge to the screen's (info).
caption_*: each card's line in its empty plate (inside x 175..397, 430..645, 677..912; y 1469..1509), 12 units in from each side, Garamond 26 as the COURT's card lines.
